effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 4 of 5 is on now: Team G (Juzo Honenuki and Jurota Shishida) as heroes against Team H (Hiryu Rin and Yui Kodai) as villains. Only Hiryu Rin and Yui Kodai are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams E, F, A, B, C, D. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team I (Nirengeki Shoda and Kosei Tsuburaba) against Team J (Shihai Kuroiro and Manga Fukidashi); Teams E, F, A, B, C, D, G, H are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 1 more round remains. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
